name: Choco
what: Ordering and AI-agent software for food and beverage distributors and their restaurant customers.
homonym_note: Not Choco Up (HK) or any confectionery 'Choco' brand.

membership.basis: Live visionaries.vc portfolio; named in the Series A coverage and as an existing backer in the Series A2.
membership.quote: Other investors include Atlantic Labs, Target Global, Visionaries Club and Greyhound.

entry.quote: closed a $33.5 million Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners

valuation.quote: pushing the company's valuation to $1.2 billion

notes: Entry: TechCrunch's Series A piece (2019-10-28) lists Visionaries Club among 'Other investors' after the Bessemer-led $33.5M Series A; the wording does not say whether each was in that round or earlier, and PYMNTS says those investors are behind the $41M raised in total (so a 2018 seed of ~$7.5M exists). Visionaries Club GmbH dates from late 2018, so the Series A is the most likely entry (medium confidence); a seed check cannot be excluded. Crunchbase News (2020-04-16) confirms Visionaries Club as an existing backer in the Coatue-led $30.2M round ('just under $250 million' valuation). TechCrunch 2022: the two tranches formed a $63.7M Series A; Series B $100M led by Left Lane (post-money $600M per TechCrunch 2022); Series B2 $111M internal round led by G Squared with Insight at $1.2B (Restaurant Business 2022-04-12; FinSMEs/TechCrunch coverage; matches the Coatue and Insight siblings). No newer priced round found through 2026-09 (Google News: OpenAI case study 2026-04-27, OpenAI voice-agent partnership 2025-12-04; no raise). Choco founder Daniel Khachab is a Visionaries LP (decisions D4); membership rests on the fund's own position, not the LP link. Focus SaaS matches both siblings.
